weighted_rule: Require explicitly known style for both artists. Weighted mean over facets documented for both artists, re-normalizing only their predefined weights. Missing facets remain absent and have no similarity score. Record shared-facet weight as evidence coverage, not a probability. Sound and arrangement remain in the whole-profile control only.
evaluation: Ranks use a common candidate set with known style for all three methods. Pilot cohort uses only original artists; validation cohort ranks new queries against original plus new artists. No threshold, forced production recommendations or degree-based correction. Frozen protocol, profiles and labels before viewing new facet scores; no post-score tuning.
validation_basis: Assistant judgments of described musical overlap, made before profile/facet scores for the additional artists. Purposive sample, not blinded, not a random sample, not a listening test. Some pairs had prior judgments in the existing review, but no pilot-profile scores.
